key_notes: File FAFSA (opens Oct 1, 2027 using 2026 PPY tax returns) and CSS Profile where required.
Eligible non-citizen (Form I-551 in hand): qualifies for federal aid via FAFSA and domestic aid pools.

I485_PENDING_C09.work_authorization: C09 EAD permits internships/co-ops without F-1 CPT/OPT
key_notes: Pending I-485 is STILL NOT FAFSA-eligible until final I-551 Green Card approval.
C09 EAD allows off-campus internships without switching to F-1; CSPA may freeze age-out.
Use CSS Profile / ISFAA and target merit-generous or Tier 1-3 colleges.

H4_DEPENDENT.work_authorization: No work authorization on H-4 (no CPT/OPT or Federal Work-Study)
key_notes: Not eligible for federal aid (FAFSA); use CSS Profile / ISFAA and target merit-generous schools.
Many states grant in-state public tuition to H-4 residents who meet state residency/HS attendance laws.

H-4 ages out at 21: switching to F-1 unlocks CPT/OPT after 1 full academic year in F-1 status, but usually forfeits in-state public tuition immediately and takes 6-12+ months via USCIS Change of Status.

F1_INTERNATIONAL.work_authorization: On-campus up to 20 hrs/wk; CPT/OPT after 1 full academic year (36-month STEM-OPT for qualifying CIP codes)
key_notes: Requires Certificate of Finances / liquid proof of Year 1 COA minus institutional aid in Spring 2028 (post-deposit) for Form I-20.
Budget $350 SEVIS I-901 fee and consular visa interview lead time.
Verify whether intended major carries a STEM-OPT CIP code and check ITAR restrictions for aerospace/defense.

TX.state_aid_program: Verify current TX Education Code § 54.052 domicile eligibility with university registrar
TX.rule_summary: H-4 visa holders with lawful 12-month TX domicile generally qualify for in-state tuition under TX Education Code § 54.052 (note: SB 1528 was enjoined in June 2025; verify current registrar policy).

CA.state_aid_program: Check UC/CSU residency office (H-4 may qualify for regular residency after 366 days physical presence + intent, distinct from AB 540)
CA.rule_summary: H-4 holders who meet UC/CSU physical presence and intent rules generally qualify for in-state tuition; F-1 holders do not.

NJ.state_aid_program: NJ Alternative Financial Aid Application (check visa eligibility)
NJ.rule_summary: NJ public universities generally grant in-state tuition to H-4 dependents with 12+ months NJ domicile; confirm with Rutgers/NJIT registrar.

NY.state_aid_program: NYS DREAM Act / SUNY residency review
NY.rule_summary: SUNY/CUNY generally evaluate H-4 students with 12-month NY domicile or NY HS graduation for in-state tuition; verify per campus.

VA.rule_summary: Virginia grants in-state tuition to H-4 dependents meeting 12-month domicile requirements; F-1 students are ineligible.

WA.state_aid_program: WASFA (Washington Application for State Financial Aid)
WA.rule_summary: Washington allows H-4 students meeting residency or HS completion criteria to qualify for in-state tuition; verify with campus registrar.

IL.rule_summary: Illinois public universities (e.g., UIUC) grant in-state tuition to H-4 dependents whose parents maintain 12-month IL domicile.
